title: Cops are not 'errand boys': PNP to review guidelines on protective assignments

blocks.text: The Philippine National Police (PNP) will review its guidelines on protective assignments to ensure police officers tasked to guard politicians, businessmen and other high-profile individuals are not being used as personal errand boys.
